consequences.heading: 20.114 The remembered Jordan-triple implication is now exact—with hypotheses
consequences.value: For a positive real symmetric response decomposed into retained, relational and interior Peirce components, \[ R=A+X+C, \] the exact effective carrier is \[ \boxed{ R_{\rm eff} =A-\{X,C^{-1},X\}. } \] In the special Jordan algebra, \(\{X,Y,X\}=XYX\), so this is precisely the Schur correction. The relationship \(X\) occupies both outer slots; the interior Green function \(C^{-1}\) occupies the middle. Recursion through positive Peirce corners is associative and, when two ports remain, lands in \(H_2(\mathbb R)_+\). Therefore the programme can finally state \[ \text{positive Peirce--Schur Jordan-triple recursion} \Longrightarrow H_2(\mathbb R) \Longrightarrow Sp(4,\mathbb R) \cong Spin_0(2,3). \] The hypotheses are essential. An arbitrary Jordan triple, arbitrary tensoring process or arbitrary endpoint does not imply \(Spin(2,3)\). The outstanding physics is to derive the real positive response and canonical two-boundary filtration from stress, causal or cellular dynamics. See [Peirce--Schur triple recursion to Spin(2,3)](../0200-0299/202_peirce_schur_triple_recursion_to_spin23.md).

nodes.title: From Positive Jordan Response to Contractive Two-Port Scattering

exactFormReason.heading: 1. Why change coordinates?
exactFormReason.value: The Jordan carrier (X\in\operatorname{Sym}_2^+(\mathbb R)) is naturally a response or impedance matrix. Experiments more often report reflection and transmission amplitudes. With positive reference impedance (Z_0), define the Cayley transform \[ S=(X-Z_0I)(X+Z_0I)^{-1}. \] Because (X) is real symmetric and commutes with every rational function of itself, (S) is real symmetric. If (x_i>0) are the eigenvalues of (X), then \[ s_i=\frac{x_i-Z_0}{x_i+Z_0} \] satisfy (|s_i|<1). Therefore \[ I-S^TS>0. \] Conversely, every real symmetric strict contraction with no eigenvalue (1) gives \[ X=Z_0(I+S)(I-S)^{-1}>0. \] Thus the positive Jordan cone and the open symmetric contraction ball are two coordinate descriptions of the same two-channel linear-response data.

exactFormReason.value: In the flag basis, the three-sheet permutation carrier decomposes as \[ \mathbb C^3=E\oplus O, \qquad E\cong\mathbb C^2, \qquad O\cong\mathbb C, \] where the residual transposition acts as \[ P=\operatorname{diag}(1,1,-1). \] The endomorphism space has the parity decomposition \[ \operatorname{End}(\mathbb C^3) = \underbrace{\left[M_2(\mathbb C)\oplus\mathbb C\right]}_{5\text{ complex, even}} \oplus \underbrace{\left[\operatorname{Hom}(O,E)\oplus\operatorname{Hom}(E,O)\right]}_{4\text{ complex, odd}}. \] For transpose-symmetric Majorana tensors, \[ \operatorname{Sym}_3(\mathbb C) = \underbrace{\left[\operatorname{Sym}_2(\mathbb C)\oplus\mathbb C\right]}_{4\text{ complex, even}} \oplus \underbrace{E}_{2\text{ complex, odd}}. \] Exact \(S_2\) kills the odd block and leaves a \(2+1\) system. Allowing an arbitrary complex odd doublet restores all six complex dimensions of a general symmetric \(3\times3\) matrix. Residual symmetry alone is therefore either too restrictive or completely nonpredictive once broken arbitrarily.

nodes.title: The Signed Class-D Localizer Does Not Descend, but a Radial Pin Localizer Survives the Boundary Test

exactFormReason.heading: 1. The theorem-backed starting point
exactFormReason.value: For a one-dimensional class-D Hamiltonian written in a Majorana basis, the reduced spectral-localizer marker is \[ z_{2,x}=\operatorname{sign}\det\!\left[ \kappa(X-xI)-iH \right]. \] The corresponding localizer gap is the smallest singular value of the reduced block; it controls stability under perturbations smaller than that gap. This is the class-D specialization used in the recent real-space dimensional-crossover analysis, while the systematic real-index theory identifies the relevant \(\mathbb Z_2\) values with Pfaffian or determinant signs of skew localizers. See the primary [class-D localizer construction](https://doi.org/10.1038/s42005-025-02382-w) and [skew-localizer real-index theorem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.09226). Our Majorana Hamiltonian has \(H_M=iA\), so the reduced block becomes the real matrix \[ B_{x,\kappa}=\kappa(X-xI)+A. \]

exactFormReason.heading: Executive result
exactFormReason.value: The three-character anchored model of document 1102 is real, even, first-order and orientable, but it cannot satisfy finite Poincaré duality. Its KO-6 intersection form is \[ \cap_3= \begin{pmatrix} 0&0&1\\ 0&0&-1\\ -1&1&0 \end{pmatrix}, \qquad \det\cap_3=0. \] This is not an accident. In KO dimension six the intersection form for complex summands is antisymmetric. Every odd-dimensional antisymmetric matrix is singular. A three-character complex model therefore cannot be Poincaré-nondegenerate. Adding a fourth character \(t\) and one \(J\)-paired spectator sector \[ (0,t)_+,\qquad(t,0)_- \] gives \[ \cap_4= \begin{pmatrix} 0&0&1&1\\ 0&0&-1&0\\ -1&1&0&0\\ -1&0&0&0 \end{pmatrix}, \qquad \det\cap_4=1. \] Thus one additional conjugate pair repairs Poincaré duality minimally. But the repair is not yet a complete geometry: if the spectator sector has no new Dirac edge, non-scalar algebra elements still commute with \(D_F\). Intersection nondegeneracy and Dirac connectedness are separate gates.

nodes.title: The Minimal Spectral Kinetic Metric Can Be Normalized to the Jordan Face, but Quartic Exchange Forces the \(Q\)-Majorana Block to Rank One

exactFormReason.heading: Executive result
exactFormReason.value: The population-normal Jordan carrier requires the two neutral scalar-copy faces to be exchange compatible. In the minimal family-block realization, their coefficient matrices are \[ C_P=PKP, \qquad C_Q=QKQ. \] The spectral kinetic trace gives \[ Z_P=\operatorname{Tr}(C_P^\dagger C_P), \qquad Z_Q=\operatorname{Tr}(C_Q^\dagger C_Q). \] Because the supports are disjoint, the kinetic Gram matrix is diagonal. Whenever \(Z_P,Z_Q>0\), canonical normalization can formally set both kinetic coefficients to one. But the normalized quartic self-couplings retain the singular-value data: \[ \rho(C) := \frac{\operatorname{Tr}\!\left[(C^\dagger C)^2\right]} {\operatorname{Tr}(C^\dagger C)^2}. \] For nonzero \(C_P\), rank one is automatic, so \[ \rho(C_P)=1. \] For a full-rank \(2\times2\) block \(C_Q\) with singular values \(s_1,s_2>0\), \[ \rho(C_Q) = \frac{s_1^4+s_2^4}{(s_1^2+s_2^2)^2} <1. \] Therefore: \[ \boxed{ \text{exact neutral-copy exchange through quartic order} \Longrightarrow \operatorname{rank}(QKQ)\le1 } \] in the minimal single-trace model. Canonical normalization alone does not derive the Jordan selector as a symmetry.

nodes.title: The Exact-Four Direct Sum Has a Two-Sided Slot Obstruction to Decorating Physical Standard-Model Fermions

exactFormReason.heading: Executive result
exactFormReason.value: The direct sum \[ \mathcal A_R^{\oplus} =\mathcal A_{\rm SM}\oplus\mathbb C_P\oplus\mathbb C_I\oplus\mathbb C_N \] has exactly the four complex characters required by the toy null-mask geometry, but it does not make \(P,I,N\) into independent family labels on the existing Standard-Model fermions. Every simple bimodule over a finite direct-sum algebra is supported on one left simple factor and one right simple factor: \[ H_{ij}=e_iH e_j^\circ. \] That gives two algebra slots, not three. A physical fermion sector already supported on two distinct internal factors—for example a weak/internal or weak/color bimodule—cannot also carry an independent direct-sum family character \(P\), \(I\), or \(N\) without replacing one of those internal supports. Thus the exact-four direct sum solves the character-counting problem only at the abstract Krajewski-point level. It cannot act as a universal family decoration of the physical Standard-Model bimodule table. This closes the simplest reading of reduced Branch R: \[ \boxed{ \text{right number of characters} \not\Longrightarrow \text{right physical family action}. } \]

At the coarse family-label level, the Dirac and Majorana relations appear to share the same carrier \(P\): \[ P\leftrightarrow I, \qquad P\leftrightarrow N. \] That coarse identification produces \[ X_{PI}\circ X_{PN}=\frac12X_{IN} \] and hence the full \(H_3(\mathbb R)\) closure established in [1126](1126_two_overlapping_H2R_null_mask_wheels_generate_H3R_and_raise_Spin23_to_Sp6.md). But the complete bimodule labels are \[ D_P=(P,N), \qquad D_I=(I,N), \] for the Dirac wheel, and \[ M_P=(P,I), \qquad M_N=(N,I), \] for the Majorana wheel. The two apparent copies of \(P\) are different relationship states because their opposite anchors differ: \[ (P,N)\ne(P,I). \] On the full relationship carrier, the two edge operators occupy orthogonal blocks. Therefore \[ X_DX_M=X_MX_D=0, \qquad X_D\circ X_M=0. \] The typed Jordan closure is \[ \boxed{ H_2(\mathbb R)_D\oplus H_2(\mathbb R)_M, } \] with local conformal algebra \[ \boxed{ \mathfrak{spin}(2,3)_D\oplus\mathfrak{spin}(2,3)_M. }

nodes.title: Three Is the Minimal Möbius Gear Cycle and the Third Relation of the Typed Twin Wheels

exactFormReason.heading: Executive result
exactFormReason.value: Yes: **three is meaningful**, and it enters at three mutually compatible levels. 1. Three is the smallest nontrivial odd gear cycle. 2. \(P,I,N\) are the three vertices of the family-relation triangle. 3. Two primary wheels sharing a coarse carrier generate a third relationship. For ordinary external gears, every contact reverses the sign of angular orientation. A closed cycle of \(n\) contacts therefore has mesh holonomy \[ h_{\rm mesh}=(-1)^n. \] An orientable planar loop closes only when \[ (-1)^n=+1, \] so \(n\) must be even. A Möbius half-twist contributes one further orientation reversal, \[ h_{\rm twist}=-1. \] The twisted closure condition is \[ h_{\rm total} =(-1)^n(-1) =+1. \] Therefore \(n\) must be odd. For the minimal case, \[ (-1)^3(-1)=+1. \] Three gears are topologically parity-consistent on a Möbius carrier even though three externally meshed gears in an ordinary planar ring are frustrated. This does not prove that an efficient literal three-gear device with realizable tooth geometry exists. It proves that parity no longer forbids it.

nodes.title: The Current KO-6 Triangle Is Two Oriented \(C_3\) Sheets, Not Yet a Möbius \(C_6\) Cover

exactFormReason.heading: Executive result
exactFormReason.value: The Möbius parity analogy is mathematically meaningful, but the current six-sector KO-6 triangle does **not yet** realize the nontrivial Möbius cover. A \(\mathbb Z_2\) double cover of the triangle \(C_3\) has two possible isomorphism types: 1. trivial holonomy: two disjoint three-cycles; 2. nontrivial holonomy: one connected six-cycle. The six oriented family sectors split as \[ PN\to NI\to IP\to PN \] and \[ NP\to PI\to IN\to NP. \] These are two separate orientation sheets exchanged by reversal. They realize the trivial double cover \[ C_3\sqcup C_3, \] not the connected Möbius lift \[ C_6. \] Therefore the half-twist is not already proved by the existence of six sectors, KO-6 chirality or the opposite-anchor split. A genuine Möbius realization requires an additional sheet-switching transport—an odd number of seams around the triangle. This creates a sharp tension. A linear seam mixing the two relational lifts can destroy the anchor protection and restore the coarse \(H_3/Sp(6)\) channel. The most promising exit is that the seam is implemented antiunitarily or categorically by \(J\), grading or a groupoid transition rather than by a new finite-Dirac one-form.

exactFormReason.heading: Executive result
exactFormReason.value: The Möbius sub-branch has reached a precise indeterminacy boundary. KO-6 reality provides the sheet-exchanging involution \[ J^2=+1, \qquad J\gamma=-\gamma J. \] But it does not specify the \(\mathbb Z_2\) connection on the \(P-I-N\) relationship triangle. For each base edge \(e\), transport may be either \[ T_e \] or \[ J\circ T_e. \] All eight assignments are equivariant under the deck involution \(J\). exactFormReason.value: The eight raw \(\mathbb Z_2\) edge assignments found in [1130](1130_KO6_reality_supplies_the_sheet_involution_but_does_not_determine_Mobius_holonomy.md) should not be carried forward as eight equally distinct physical models. Three filters reduce them without choosing between trivial and Möbius holonomy: 1. vertex-sheet gauge transformations reduce the eight assignments to two cohomology classes; 2. strict cyclic covariance selects one symmetric representative of each class; 3. homogeneous \(\mathbb Z_2\) degree identifies those representatives as the all-even and all-odd transports. The surviving canonical candidates are \[ t_{\mathrm{even}}=(0,0,0), \qquad t_{\mathrm{odd}}=(1,1,1). \] Their holonomies are \[ h_{\mathrm{even}}=0, \qquad h_{\mathrm{odd}}=1, \] because a three-cycle has \[ h=3d=d\pmod 2 \] for homogeneous edge degree (d). The odd branch gives the connected (C_6) cover.

nodes.title: Binary Jordan Composition Selects the Trivial Cover while Odd Jordan-Triple Recursion Selects the Möbius Cover

exactFormReason.heading: Executive result
exactFormReason.value: The trivial/Möbius fork is not an arbitrary topological decoration. It matches an exact algebraic distinction between binary and ternary Jordan composition. Let (x,y,z) be grading-odd relationship operators: \[ \gamma x=-x\gamma, \qquad \gamma y=-y\gamma, \qquad \gamma z=-z\gamma. \] Their binary Jordan product \[ x\circ z=\frac12(xz+zx) \] is grading-even: \[ [\gamma,x\circ z]=0. \] Their Jordan triple product \[ \{x,y,z\} =\frac12(xy^*z+zy^*x) \] is grading-odd: \[ \gamma\{x,y,z\}=-\{x,y,z\}\gamma. \] Therefore, if operator degree is the \(\mathbb Z_2\) sheet-transport variable on the \(P-I-N\) triangle, then \[ \boxed{ \text{binary Jordan composition} \Longrightarrow C_3\sqcup C_3, } \] whereas \[ \boxed{ \text{Jordan-triple recursion} \Longrightarrow C_6. } \] This is conditional only at the bridge: the graded parity theorem is exact, while the physical model must still prove that its triangle edges are the corresponding homogeneous operators.

exactFormReason.value: The first typed Jordan-triple closure test gives one positive result and one obstruction. Take the two coarse spokes from the common carrier \(P\): \[ a=E_{PI}, \qquad b=E_{PN}. \] Their row space \[ R=\operatorname{span}\{a,b\} \] is closed under the Jordan triple product \[ \{x,y,z\}=\frac12(xy^*z+zy^*x). \] No triple product leaves \(R\), so ternary composition does not create a forbidden new odd carrier. This is exactly the type-preservation wanted from the relational language. However, it also means that two odd spokes do **not** generate a third odd \(I-N\) edge. Instead, \[ a^*b=E_{IN} \] appears in the right linking algebra \[ R^*R, \] which is an even coefficient/observable algebra. Therefore: \[ \boxed{ \text{typed triple closure preserves the mask but does not complete an odd Möbius triangle}. } \] A physical \(C_6\) with three odd edges requires an independent typed odd \(I-N\) relation or a Real/groupoid operation that lifts the even linking coefficient into an odd relation.

nodes.title: The Shiab analogy identifies the missing operation but not yet a well-defined Jordan transport

exactFormReason.heading: Finding
exactFormReason.value: The proposed “living mediation” has a close conceptual precedent in Eric Weinstein’s **Shiab** or **Ship in a Bottle** construction. The resemblance is not superficial. A Shiab operator is intended to solve a transport problem: geometrical differential-form indices and internal gauge-bundle indices transform differently, so an ordinary contraction can destroy gauge covariance. The proposed remedy is to incorporate the transforming internal datum into the contraction itself. This is strikingly close to the gap in the present programme: \[ \text{Jordan rank split} \longrightarrow \text{fermion-module action} \longrightarrow \text{gauge-covariant dynamics} \longrightarrow \text{boundary response}. \] However, “use a Shiab operator” is not yet a solution. In Geometric Unity the construction is a large and underdetermined family of bespoke contraction operators, and its published formulation has serious mathematical objections. The productive move is to extract its design principle and formulate a smaller, typed **Jordan–Shiab problem** adapted to the rank-split system.

nodes.title: The projector curvature contains an exact factor three but a composite connection does not yet supply the BF carrier

exactFormReason.heading: Result
exactFormReason.value: The first systematic reduction of the Jordan–Shiab idea gives two conclusions. 1. A zeroth-order Shiab-like current linear in \(D_{\mathcal A}P\) and a curvature \(F\) can be written covariantly, but it vanishes when the connection and curvature preserve the selected rank split. It therefore probes motion *away from* the reduced phase and cannot by itself be the surviving \(U(1)_X\) gauge principle. 2. The quadratic projector curvature obeys the exact identity \[ -i\operatorname{Tr}\!\left(X\,DP\wedge DP\right) =3i\operatorname{Tr}\!\left(P\,DP\wedge DP\right), \qquad X=I-3P. \] Up to the sign convention for the Berry curvature, this is exactly three times the curvature of the selected tautological line. It is therefore a concrete geometric source of a level-three coefficient. However, a connection composed only from \(P\) does not automatically possess the independent flat holonomy sectors required for the nine-state BF carrier. The factor three is derived; the full topological gauge field is not yet derived.

nodes.title: Peirce decomposition is the Jordan-native language for the selected object, its context, and the relations between them

exactFormReason.heading: Executive answer
exactFormReason.value: Peirce decomposition is not a new physical hypothesis introduced late in the programme. It is the standard Jordan-algebra decomposition determined by an idempotent projector \(P\). The programme had already been using it under other names: \[ \text{selected family} \;\oplus\; \text{remaining pair} \;\oplus\; \text{off-diagonal relations}. \] In Jordan-native language these are the Peirce spaces \[ J_1(P), \qquad J_0(P), \qquad J_{1/2}(P). \] For \(J=\operatorname{Herm}_3(\mathbb C)\), with \(Q=I-P\), they are \[ \begin{aligned} J_1(P)&=PJP,\\ J_0(P)&=QJQ,\\ J_{1/2}(P)&=PJQ\oplus QJP \quad\text{as a real Hermitian relation space}. \end{aligned} \] The angle is that Peirce decomposition separates **things** from the **relations that connect them**. The rank split supplies two diagonal faces, while the half-Peirce sector is the relational carrier between them.

nodes.title: Degree ten also cannot isolate the three-family frame, so twelve is the first unexcluded order

exactFormReason.heading: Main result
exactFormReason.value: The degree-eight obstruction extends one rung further. The invariant ring of two generic \(3\times3\) matrices has no primitive generator of word length five. Its mixed generators below length six occur at lengths two, three and four; the next primitive generator occurs at length six. This is the classical Teranishi generator theorem, in the explicit presentation of [Aslaksen, Drensky and Sadikova](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0405389). For the fixed-spectrum two-Hermitian orientation problem, this means that every potential through total Yukawa degree ten has the form \[ \boxed{ V_{\le10}(y)=c_0+\sum_{i=1}^4c_i y_i +\alpha y_1^2+\beta y_1y_2+\gamma y_1y_3, } \] where \[ y_1=\operatorname{Tr}(AB),\quad y_2=\operatorname{Tr}(A^2B),\quad y_3=\operatorname{Tr}(AB^2),\quad y_4=\operatorname{Tr}(A^2B^2) \] are generic local coordinates on the four-dimensional relative-frame space. The stationary Hessian is never positive definite. Indeed, if \(\beta\) or \(\gamma\) is nonzero it is indefinite; if both vanish it has rank at most one. Thus: \[ \boxed{ \text{total Yukawa degree ten cannot produce a strict isolated generic three-family mixing minimum.} } \]

Its spectral frame is therefore \(\mathfrak F\) for every input frame. The return map is the identity on the whole flag manifold, not a selector. Thus completing the projector to a frame fixes the *type* of missing object but does not generate its relative orientation.

nodes.title: Current evidence supports small heterogeneous practice effects but not a Christian-specific field tilt

declaredStatus.value: external-evidence audit; strong uniqueness claim unsupported

exactFormReason.heading: Result
exactFormReason.value: The available evidence makes a broad practice-effect hypothesis plausible but does not presently identify a Christian-specific field tilt. A 2024 meta-analysis covering 701 effects, 237 samples and 811,663 participants found religiosity associated with prosociality at (r=.13), but the association was (r=.15) for self-report and only (r=.06) for directly measured behaviour, with substantial heterogeneity. This is evidence against using testimony alone as the main outcome ([Kelly, Kramer and Shariff 2024](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38407059/)). A 2026 target-trial emulation across six annual waves found that deterministic "make everyone attend" contrasts failed positivity because only about 2--3% of non-attenders initiated monthly attendance per year. Supported stochastic interventions produced selective small gains in meaning, purpose, forgiveness and sexual satisfaction, with little movement in distress, somatic health, belonging or perceived support ([Bulbulia et al. 2026](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13122395/)). The result rejects both a global-benefit story and a simple social-contact reduction, but does not isolate Christianity or divine agency.

nodes.title: Time-varying participation is not causally identified by cross-sectional or complete-case comparison

declaredStatus.value: causal-identification boundary and executable design requirements

exactFormReason.heading: Result
exactFormReason.value: Religious participation is a time-varying exposure with feedback. Let (A_t) be participation, (L_t) mental health, social support, expectancy and life circumstances, and (Y) a later outcome. The causal structure includes \[ A_t\to L_{t+1}\to A_{t+1}, \qquad L_t\to A_t, \qquad L_t\to Y. \] A cross-sectional difference (E[Y\mid A=1]-E[Y\mid A=0]) therefore mixes treatment, selection, reverse causation and survivor effects. Conditioning only on programme completion adds post-treatment selection. Longitudinal religion-and-mental-health methods explicitly identify feedback: attendance may affect depression while depression affects later attendance. Appropriate analyses require prior exposure, prior outcome and time-varying confounders, sometimes through marginal structural models ([VanderWeele, Jackson and Li 2016](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27631394/)).

exactFormReason.heading: Result
exactFormReason.value: Write a real symmetric two-by-two matrix as \[ X(t,x,y)=\begin{pmatrix}t+x&y\\y&t-x\end{pmatrix}. \] Then \[ \det X=t^2-x^2-y^2, \] and $X$ is positive definite exactly when \[ t>\sqrt{x^2+y^2}. \] Thus the established positive Jordan cone $H_2(\mathbb R)_+$ is not merely compatible with an unoriented Lorentz cone: it is exactly one component, the future timelike cone, of the $1+2$-dimensional determinant form. Its rank-one boundary is the future null cone. For every connected structure transformation $X\mapsto AXA^T$, positivity is preserved and \[ \det(AXA^T)=\det(A)^2\det X. \] Translations, structure transformations, and co-translations give the Jordan conformal completion \[ Sp(4,\mathbb R)\cong Spin_0(2,3), \] the identity component rather than compact $Spin(5)$ or a time-reversing component. The positive order therefore selects the causal orientation of the programme's mathematical carrier.
